name: ANEMO PRIME
india_angle: Anemo Prime has a manufacturing unit in Bawal, Haryana, and a corporate office in Gurugram, indicating a strong presence in India.
summary: Anemo Prime specializes in providing HVAC engineering and turnkey solutions, focusing on energy-efficient systems for cleanrooms and industrial facilities. While their core business is not centered on semiconductors, their solutions can support semiconductor manufacturing environments.
